Find exchange courses – Østfold University of Applied Sciences
Find exchange courses
Østfold University of Applied Sciences offer a wide range of subjects that are suitable for exchange students. This page provides quick links to find course information. In addition to our courses taught in English, we offer online courses in German, French and Spanish.
Suggested course combinations
Communication and Media
Business and IT
International Business Programme
Engineering a Sustainable Future
Organising for sustainability and innovation
Nordic Citizenship Education
English in Teacher Education
Communication and English Language Courses
English Language Courses
French Language Courses
Spanish Language Courses
German Language Courses
Norwegian as a Foreign Language
How to choose courses?
Students should choose courses relevant to their academic background and consult their home coordinator before applying. We recommend that you apply for courses from the same faculty to ensure that you avoid any clashes in your timetable. You can read about the prerequisites and course requirements in the course descriptions.
In order to take master-level courses, you must meet the admission requirements for the corresponding
master's degree programmes
.
Credits per semester:
30 ECTS (studiepoeng)
Courses per semester:
2 or 3 depending on the credits
Please note that the course catalogue for the 2025/2026 school is not yet finalized and will be continuously updated.
